name: Project Garuda
description: Project Jatayu designs & develops Autonomous Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Founded in 2009 by six RVCE students it was one of India's first student-led UAV teams. We aim to create intelligent, autonomous drones. We leverage new cutting-edge technology to address real-world challenges.We build autonomous systems for real-world applications , develop embedded electronics, custom PCB solutions and integrate AI & Computer Vision into UAV platforms.We also perform simulation, structural analysis and experimental validation along with  participating in college-level and  national competitions.

events.name: Drone Assembly/Disassembly
events.detail: Get hands-on with drone hardware by assembling and disassembling a quadcopter. Learn the purpose of key components such as the flight controller, ESCs, motors, propellers, and battery while testing your speed, precision, and technical understanding.

events.name: Piloting
events.detail: Experience the thrill of flying a drone through a realistic flight simulator. Navigate checkpoints, avoid obstacles, and master basic flight controls in a safe virtual environment that introduces the fundamentals of drone piloting.

events.name: Drone Escape Room
events.detail: Work as a team to solve a series of drone-themed puzzles and challenges before time runs out. Decode clues, identify components, complete mini assembly tasks, and overcome interactive obstacles to unlock your way to the final mission

events.name: Drone Passport
events.detail: Embark on a drone exploration journey by collecting stamps from a variety of interactive stations. From quizzes and simulator flights to FPV demonstrations, computer vision showcases, and hands-on activities, each station offers a unique glimpse into the world of drones and UAV technology.
